trail.name: Static Peak Divide
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Death Canyon Trailhead marker; 2.0 m from reviewed route/access geometry. This is an area forecast reference, not navigation or uniform conditions along the route.
trail.planningNote: Access restriction reviewed September 5, 2026: NPS reports the old Death Canyon road and trailhead closed, including to pedestrians. These published distances use that old start; do not use them for an alternate trailhead or the future relocated start. Check NPS construction updates before planning. Long, steep mountain hike: check current conditions with a backcountry ranger. Snow travel may require specialist skills and equipment. The trailhead-area forecast does not represent the higher route. TrailPack covers day-hike packing, not climbing or overnight equipment. Turn around at Static Peak Divide, not Static Peak summit.

additionalSources.note: Official NPS activity-map configuration used to identify the named route corridor; alternate access routes and branches are not silently substituted.
NPS reports the old trailhead closed to all traffic and says relocation will lengthen hikes. Saved route statistics must be re-reviewed for the new start; alternative access has different distances.

comparison.note: Reviewed NPS-origin USGS segments, with clipped sections and return legs counted explicitly, total 16.065 mi (0.4% versus NPS). This is route-corridor evidence, not a navigation track.
